entities.title: The rig contract
entities.summary: What every ship GLB must hold for the import script and the ship script.
consumers: The scripted Blender pipeline that makes the models, outside this repository
guarantees: Moving parts are separate nodes with glTF extras: kind (turret, door, missile, brake …) and their axis, amount and sign
The import copies each extra to node metadata rig_<key>; ship.gd groups parts by rig_kind
Forward is +X in the GLB; the import turns it to Godot's −Z
Textures on the second UV set are moved to the first unless the root's textures_on_uv2 extra is false
entities.compatibility: DESIGN § Rig contract adds marker empties (muzzle, exhaust, beacon, launch, mount) that the scripts do not read yet.
